privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your personal data

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.text: INESA (Food Sensory Evaluation Institute), based in Houston, Texas, United States, is the controller of personal data collected through this website. Contact: yamilaec{'@'}yahoo.com.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
sections.text: We may collect: name, email, and message when you use the contact form; technical browsing data (approximate IP, device type, pages visited) via cookies or analytics; and account data if you register for INESA Academy (email, name, and course progress).

sections.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis
sections.text: We use your data to respond to inquiries, deliver sensory evaluation and training services, improve the website, and meet legal obligations. The legal basis may be consent, contract performance, or INESA’s legitimate interest.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and analytics
sections.text: This site may use necessary technical cookies and, when enabled, Google Analytics 4 to measure visits in aggregate. You can configure your browser to reject non-essential cookies.

sections.title: 5. Retention and recipients
sections.text: We keep data only as long as needed for the stated purpose or as required by law. We do not sell personal data. Hosting and analytics providers (e.g. Vercel) may process data under processor agreements.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.text: Where applicable (including GDPR), you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, or objection by emailing yamilaec{'@'}yahoo.com. You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.title: 7. Security and children
sections.text: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data. This site is not directed at children under 16.

sections.title: 8. Changes
sections.text: We may update this policy. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.
